name: linkrra
description: Synap by Linkrra: open-weight models (Qwen3 Coder, Qwen3, Gemma 4, gpt-oss) served on Linkrra's own GPUs behind an OpenAI-compatible API, billed per token. Every listed model supports tool calling and streaming.
setup_steps: Sign in at https://synap.linkrra.com/ai/account.html and create an API key (qwen3-coder-30b has a free tier of 100,000 tokens/day)
Paste the key as LINKRRA_API_KEY (or export LINKRRA_API_KEY in your shell)
Pick a model: qwen3-coder-30b is the recommended default for coding sessions
